row.evidence: Vitally's Okta SSO guide says "No, SCIM connections for Okta SSO are not supported at this time"; team members are created by SAML just-in-time provisioning on first login.
row.notes: Quote-only: all three plans (Tech-Touch, Hybrid-Touch, High-Touch) say Request Pricing, and the pricing page lists Single Sign-on under 'Included in All Plans'. No SCIM; the only automation is SAML JIT, with the vitallyRole attribute setting the role on every login. Once SAML is on, in-app invites are disabled. Off-boarding is manual (log out sessions, deactivate licence, which frees the seat). The REST API exposes team members (Admins) read-only.

deprovision.notes: No SCIM. Manual off-boarding: an admin logs the member out of all sessions and deactivates the licence in Team Settings; deactivation frees the seat immediately; no self-service delete (c8, c12, c13).

limitations.text: Vitally's Okta guide says SCIM connections are not supported; no SCIM endpoint is documented for any IdP.

auth.notes: API key sent as the Basic auth username; keys are created under Settings > Integrations > Vitally REST API.

capabilities.notes: The Admins resource (Vitally's own team members) is read-only: list, search by email and fetch. Name and email are editable only in-app; role is not editable. The 'Users' resource in the REST API is the customer's end-customers, not Vitally seats.

endpoints.purpose: Look up an Admin by email

rate_limits.text: 1000 requests/min token bucket; writes may count as more than one request

limitations.text: No API endpoint to create, update, deactivate or delete team members (Admins); the Admin object's name and email are edited in-app only.

okta.notes: Vitally documents a custom SAML app ('Create New App'), not an OIN catalogue app; okta.com/integrations/vitally/ returned 404. No SCIM.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (learn.microsoft.com vitally-tutorial 404); Vitally says it supports any SAML IdP via manual setup.

google.notes: Vitally has an 'SSO via Google' SAML guide; no Google provisioning.

onelogin.notes: Vitally has an 'SSO via OneLogin' SAML guide; OneLogin catalogue not checked (bot-blocked).

open_questions: Plan prices are not public (all plans 'Request Pricing').
No documented webhook for team-member events or audit-log API.
Whether team members can be bulk-imported by CSV is not documented.
